title: Check linked inputs and ordinary output parity

context.hint: Keep manifest-controlled input reads within the resolved packet root.
context.surface: A local report rebuilder opens data files named by an imported packet manifest.
assumptions: The manifest may be supplied by another party.
Use disposable packet roots and synthetic data.

review.invariant: Resolved link targets obey packet containment and accepted inputs retain their documented output.
review.verification: In a temporary packet, compare an in-root normalized reference with a link to outside fixture data. Deny the outside target and compare ordinary report and summary bytes against baseline output.

source_observation.summary: The repaired reader denied the outside link and accepted the in-root normalized reference. Five targeted checks passed and ordinary report and summary bytes matched baseline. Scorer reconstruction was outside this review.
